knowledge_sources.source: Building AI Agents with LLMs, RAG, and Knowledge Graphs

instructions.instruction: Analyze all settled trade batches from Binance Demo execution.

Post-Mortem Root Cause Extraction: - Scan every loss event in data/loss_events.json for patterns (RSI overbought, Counter-H4 trend, Low volume fakeout). - Quantify percentage distribution of failure modes.

Continuous Strategy Evolution: - Synthesize directive constraints (e.g. adjust RSI threshold from 70 to 65, enforce volume_ratio >= 1.0x). - Instruct Tier 2 (Optimizer) to compile patched strategy into sandbox. - Continue autonomous batch iterations until overall system win rate sustains >= 80%.
